Also, it allows write-back to various data sources directly from within the tool. Quick and easy project management, Master data, Comments and analysis. WHY accoMASTERDATA? If you want to optimize and professionalize any master data process that requires manual input from your employees, then accoMASTERDATA can help you. accoMASTERDATA is a simple and very flexible solution based on Power BI functionality. It can support any process that requires values, text or date/time input from employees around the organization.
